title: Create landing page for making money online with CTA buttons

requirements.text: Create a landing page with a 'make money online' theme that includes 5-6 prominent call-to-action (CTA) buttons, each linking to https://globalnewsdesk727.blogspot.com

quotes: Please create a landing page for me about make money online which will have 5-6 STA buttons and add this link to all the buttons

acceptanceCriteria: Landing page displays 5-6 distinct CTA buttons
All CTA buttons link to https://globalnewsdesk727.blogspot.com
Page theme clearly relates to making money online

requirements.text: Add a contact button to the landing page with appropriate styling and placement

quotes: there will be a contract button

acceptanceCriteria: Contact button is visible and accessible on the landing page
Contact button styling matches the overall design theme

requirements.text: Design the landing page with a creative, professional visual theme that avoids blue and purple colors, using a distinct style with cohesive typography, color palette, and layout that conveys trust and opportunity in the online earning space
acceptanceCriteria: Visual design is cohesive and professional
Color scheme avoids blue and purple
Typography and layout create a polished appearance

nonGoals: Backend integration for contact form submission

required: Hero background image showing laptop and money symbols in warm tones (hero-background.dim_1920x1080.png)
Icon representing online earning opportunity with gradient effect (earning-icon.dim_256x256.png)
